headings.usage: Page titles, KPI numbers, Dashboard section headers.

body.usage: Data tables, transaction logs, input fields, labels. Highly recommended for tabular figures ensuring numbers align perfectly in accounting grids.

colors.description: A serious, Tally-like professional color scheme. Functional color semantics with a muted slate structural base. Absolute NO teal green/blue. NO purple/violet.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces. NO Glassmorphism for data panels. High information density demands crisp, opaque backgrounds to avoid refraction of data.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp solid lines (`border-slate-200`). Expose the grid skeleton in tables.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Soft ambient shadow for hover states only (`shadow-sm`). Use borders for structure, not shadows.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Functional and instructive (e.g., 'No receipts generated today' with a subtle grey icon), avoiding excessive illustration.

component_guidelines.data_tables: High-density / compact rows (40px height). Sticky headers, frozen first columns. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for tabular figures. Zebra striping for readability.
component_guidelines.kpi_cards: Compact card grids. Left-aligned label, massive right-aligned or bottom-aligned number. Subtle variance indicator (e.g., '+2% from yesterday').
component_guidelines.receipt_engine: Print-friendly A4/A5 layouts. High-contrast black and white preview. Absolute minimalist layout, mimicking physical paper. Remove shadows and sidebars when printing.
component_guidelines.forms: Dense input fields. Use Shadcn Input/Select. Left-aligned labels for rapid tab-key navigation. Mandatory remarks field must have a prominent red asterisk.

grids.main_content: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 (Sidebar col-span-1, Main Table col-span-3)

layouts.app_structure: Left Navigation Sidebar (Dark Slate) + Top Action Bar (White) + Main Content Area (Light Slate Background).
layouts.spacing_system: Compact spacing for utility. `p-4` or `p-6` for main containers, tight `gap-2` or `gap-4` for data elements.
layouts.header: Solid white background (`bg-white`). No transparency. Must contain Breadcrumbs and user role badge (e.g., Cashier/Admin).

motion.philosophy: Minimalist. Cashiers using the app 8 hours/day do not want bouncy animations.
motion.interactions: Instant hover states. Fast transitions (`duration-150`). No parallax or delayed entrances.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark text on light background. No light grey text on white.
accessibility.keyboard: Full keyboard navigability. Cashiers must be able to generate receipts without touching the mouse. Visible `focus-visible:ring-2` on all inputs.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="generate-receipt-button"`).

image_urls.description: Quiet, sunlit empty classroom with wooden desks
image_urls.category: Login Screen Backdrop (left or right split panel)

media.icons: lucide-react. Use thin stroke weights (1.5px) for a professional look.

3d_libraries.recommendation: NONE. This is a highly dense financial accounting software. 3D elements will distract and reduce performance. Use Recharts for 2D data visualization if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize data density. Do not use excessive padding inside data tables.
Implement Role-Based Access Control UI explicitly (show/hide admin menus based on role).
For the unified receipt engine, ensure the CSS is `@media print` optimized (hide sidebars, remove shadows).
Implement global search component in the top header (Search by admission no / name / mobile / receipt no).
Add `data-testid` to every single button, input, and table row.
Ensure all components are strictly written in .js files, NOT .tsx files.
OVERRIDE UNIVERSAL GLASSMORPHISM RULE: Due to the high-density financial nature of this specific app, strictly use Flat Solid Surfaces instead of Glassmorphism to ensure data legibility.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js`.
